Lẩu Tokbokki 즉석떡볶이 · Jeukseok Tteokbokki hotpot

A top-down race around a hotpot restaurant. The table with the VN × KR flags spins slowly in the middle, and plates of ingredients turn with it. Run with your joystick, grab what your recipe needs and bring it home to your pot. Tap the joystick at a rival's pot to steal from it, and bump people to knock their ingredient loose. The first perfect hotpot wins.

2 or 4 players, all at onceJoystick + tapSpinning tableSteal and bump60 s

A round

1 · Recipe

Your own order

Each player gets a random recipe: 5 ingredients, at most 2 of one kind. The card sits beside your pot, turned toward you.

2 · Grab

Catch the plate

The table turns 10° a second, a full turn every 36 s, so you keep moving to meet the plate you need. Walking close picks it up automatically, but only if your recipe still needs it. You carry one at a time.

3 · Cook

Bring it home

Walk into your own pen and a needed ingredient drops into your pot.

4 · Perfect

First full pot wins

All 5 slots filled and nothing spoiled inside: the pot switches to the full art and the round ends at once.

Joystick: walk and tap

  • Drag to walk. The further you drag, the faster you go. It's the same joystick as in Tách Kẹo.
  • Tap (a quick press without dragging) is your action. What it does depends on where you are:
Where you tapHands emptyCarrying something
At a rival's potSteal the last ingredient they addedPut it in their pot. If they need it, it fills their slot. If not, it's spoiled: it doesn't count, and it stops their pot from being perfect.
At your own potTake a spoiled ingredient outPut it in your pot
Anywhere elseNothingDrop it on the floor

After a steal, that pot is safe for 1.5 s, so one player can't empty it in a second. Floor items stay for 8 s, and anyone who needs them can pick them up.

Bumping

Players push each other on contact. Running into someone at more than about 80% of full speed knocks their ingredient onto the floor and stuns them for 0.4 s. The faster player keeps what they're carrying.

The table

RuleValue
Plate slots around the rim12
Filled at the start8
New plate after one is taken1.5 s, in the same slot
Which ingredient comes back70% something a player still needs, 30% random
Spin10° per second, clockwise; the flags stay upright

Winning

Perfect pot

The first player with all 5 slots filled and nothing spoiled wins immediately. Everyone else ranks by how many correct ingredients are in their pot.

60 s up

The player with the most correct ingredients wins. Spoiled items don't count.

Draw

If two or more players share the highest count at 60 s, it's a draw.

Fun facts

  • 즉석떡볶이 means “instant tteokbokki”: rice cakes, fish cake, egg and ramyeon cooked at your own table in a shallow pot of spicy broth.
  • Vietnam has lẩu and Korea has jeongol. Both are shared from one pot in the middle of the table.
  • Tteokbokki restaurants where you pick your own ingredients from a buffet are popular with young people in Vietnam.
